entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Cannot rename generic parameter with `new()` constraint on instantiation #78649
  • In RoslynAnalyzers, change Microsoft.CodeAnalysis package references to project references #78643
  • »replace property with methods« creates an error in Visual Studio for undefined types #78642
  • Compiling with instrumentation does not generate unique coverage array per method #78640
  • VS Diagnostic analyzer runner - ArgumentOutOfRangeException - Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Text.LinePosition #78639
  • C# Preview 10.0.100-preview.4.25258.110 Massive Compile Errors with Async Extension #78638
  • `nameof` doesn't work with extension properties #78636

Closed

  • Do not use CanApplyChanges to skip applying mapped file changes #47908
    Backlog
  • [LSP] Enable server options via IBrokeredSettingsManager #48567
    Backlog
  • Invalid code is emitted for a user-defined conditional logical operator #78609
  • [Bug] Error loading project for misc file in VSCode #78591
  • Signature help shows wrong thing in nested context #68600
    18.0
  • Fix LSP tooltips that are generated as markdown from doc comments #53358
    Backlog
  • FileBasedProgramsProjectSystem is creating bin and obj directories in the user's folder if they open a random .cs that's not a file-based program #78589
  • False CS8602 is raised by Roslyn when an IEnumerable<T> is implied to be null #78635
  • extension syntax bug #78346
    Next

  • Fixing symbol publishing #78650
  • (WIP) Invoke `dotnet run-api` to obtain virtual project #78648

    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything

    Area-Compilers, Community

  • Merge 'main' into 'extensions' #78600
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Convert operand of `true`/`false` operator invoked as part of `&&`/`||`operator evaluation #78629
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Ensure return local is the correct type for runtime async #78603
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • LSP: Fix batch builds for file-based programs and fix `"dotnet.projects.binaryLogPath"` throwing an exception #78644
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Support local functions in outline/breadcrumbs #78605
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Implement "non-generic method is better" rule in operator overload resolution #78633
